title: Inebriated Fellows 2026
description: The modpack for the 2026 Inebriated Fellows server ran by Xipheus.
body:
This is the client-side modpack for the 2026 Inebriated Fellows vanilla+ minecraft server. Upkept and ran by Xipheus.

Mod is a generally vanilla+ modpack that also includes added structures, enhanced cooking/farming systems, furniture, and improvements to the overall game.
